name: Mento Colombian Peso
oneLiner: COPm is Mento's Colombian peso stablecoin on Celo, minted CDP-style against USDm collateral (Mento V3, a Liquity v2 fork).
collateral: Mento V3 Liquity-v2-style CDPs collateralized by USDm; USDm in turn is backed by the diversified Mento Reserve mix (sUSDS, CELO, EURC, USDC, USDT, axlEUROC, stETH, and smaller positions exposed via the Mento reserve dashboard).
pegMechanism: Mento V3 oracle-priced FX stablecoin minted by depositing USDm as CDP collateral and borrowing COPm against it; user-set interest rates, Stability Pool liquidations, and Liquity-style redemptions support the COPm peg, with circuit breakers and Mento reserve transparency on the upstream USDm leg.

oracleRisk.summary: COPm's live Celo USDm/COPm Broker exchange uses one SortedOracles reporter with a 360-second report-expiry window and minimumReports set to one; BreakerBox gates the swap but no second feed or failover path is configured.

branchApplicability.rationale: At Celo block 72127154, COPm broker() returned the Mento v2 Broker and BiPoolManager exposed one USDm/COPm exchange using rate feed 0x0196D1F4FdA21fA442e53EaF18Bf31282F6139F1, minimumReports 1, and a 360-second reset/expiry window. SortedOracles had one reporter for that feed. The current Mento reserve API lists active CDP troves only for GBPm, JPYm, and CHFm, not COPm, so COPm has no live borrower-specific oracle/liquidation branch to enumerate.

sources.label: COP/USD rate feed on Celo Blockscout

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: The current holder-facing COPm token has no direct blacklist, freeze, pause, seizure, arbitrary-account burn, or transfer-hook restriction. Timelocked proxy upgrade authority is recorded in mint-authority evidence but is not itself a currently executable holder-freeze surface. This direct conclusion does not suppress reserve-derived upstream exposure.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: COPm's sole tracked Celo deployment is a Mento StableTokenV2/Broker asset. The pinned backing configuration identifies COPm as reserve-backed rather than a borrower CDP. StableTokenV2 exposes ordinary transfer and transferFrom, permissioned minting, and self-burn only; it has no direct blacklist, freeze, pause, seizure, arbitrary-holder burn, or transfer hook. The direct token-level freeze posture is therefore No as of this review. The shared Mento Reserve's USDT, EURC, and USDC-family collateral remains separately represented and can still produce computed upstream exposure.

mintAuthority.summary: COPm is minted via the Mento Broker (0x777A...) which is the sole authorized minter (broker() getter confirmed). The Broker's proxy admin and the COPm token owner and proxy admin all resolve to the Mento Timelock (0x890DB...) with a 2-day delay.

upgradeability.controlRef: Mento Timelock — COPm token owner and proxy admin

controls.label: Mento Broker — authorized minter for COPm
controls.evidence: At Celo block 69287341, broker() on COPm (0x8a567e2ae79ca692bd748ab832081c45de4041ea) returned 0x777A8255cA72412f0d706dc03C9D1987306B4CaD (Mento BrokerProxy). The Broker's EIP-1967 proxy admin slot returned 0x890DB8A597940165901372Dd7DB61C9f246e2147 (Mento Timelock).

controls.label: Mento Timelock — COPm token owner and proxy admin
controls.evidence: At Celo block 69287341, owner() on COPm returned 0x890DB8A597940165901372Dd7DB61C9f246e2147; EIP-1967 proxy admin slot returned the same address. getMinDelay() on the Timelock returned 0x2a300 = 172800 seconds (48 hours).

review.evidence: At Celo block 69287341: owner() = Timelock 0x890DB8A597940165901372Dd7DB61C9f246e2147 (confirmed); EIP-1967 proxy admin slot = same Timelock; getMinDelay() = 172800s (48h); broker() = 0x777A8255cA72412f0d706dc03C9D1987306B4CaD (Mento BrokerProxy, confirmed as sole authorized minter); Broker EIP-1967 proxy admin = same Timelock. Celo Registry confirms Broker = 0x777A... All mint-capable surfaces resolved. Economically, Broker issuance is the collateral-exchange path; changing that path or authorizing different mint logic requires the independently enforced 48-hour Mento Timelock, so the encoding-derived unbounded cap is superseded by raiseable semantics.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: COPm has a single Celo deployment in the reviewed metadata and Celo's local-stablecoin docs list COPm as a Mento stablecoin on Celo. No material bridge route is resolved for this row.
bridgeRouteRisk.reviewer: Codex bridge route review; Kimi P2 control cohort dc-5 (lead usd1-world-liberty-financial)

routes.reviewNote: On-chain 2026-07-20: COPm is the Mento StableToken whose sole authorized minter is the Mento Broker 0x777a8255ca72412f0d706dc03c9d1987306b4cad (broker() getter), with token owner and proxy admin both resolving to the Mento Timelock 0x890Db8a597940165901372Dd7Db61C9f246e2147, matching the reviewed mintAuthority. Issuer-native deployment; no bridge control carries the claim.

reserves.name: CELO
reserves.issuerOrObligor: Celo network native asset held by Mento Reserve governance

reserveReview.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-7 (lead tusd-trueusd)
reserveReview.rationale: The prior aggregate USDm wrapper slice could not classify the live Mento adapter rows, leaving the CELO and stETH reserve exposures unstructured. The envelope is restated on the adapter's exact constituent identities and 2026-07-20 captured weights from the issuer-run reserve analytics API; each stablecoin constituent links to its tracked asset, and CELO and stETH now carry explicit classification and failure-domain identity. The live adapter refreshes weights at runtime.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Mento reserve analytics API constituent identities and weights captured 2026-07-20; COPm is reserve-backed via the shared Mento Reserve per Mento's backing registry
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Every constituent of the shared Mento Reserve captured by the live adapter is identified and either linked to a tracked stablecoin or explicitly classified. Constituent weights drift and are refreshed by the live adapter.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: CELO is the Celo network native asset held as external reserve collateral, not a tracked stablecoin dependency.
stETH is external liquid-staking collateral, not a tracked stablecoin dependency.

custodyProfile.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-7 (lead tusd-trueusd)
custodyProfile.uncertainty: Reserve assets are held in the on-chain Mento Reserve contract under Mento governance rather than with a legal custodian, so legal segregation, insolvency treatment, and reuse restrictions are not established by the reviewed sources; constituent-level custody (e.g. Circle, Tether, Lido) sits with each issuer.

notices.title: Peg grouped as Other
notices.message: COP is not yet a first-class Pharos peg-currency enum, so COPm is grouped under OTHER while the DefiLlama price and circulating-supply path admits the asset at runtime.
